text: きみ　なんて　あたしで　じゅうぶん！

structure.jp: あたしで　じゅうぶん！

patterns.name: 〜なんて
patterns.explanation: なんて after a person or thing shows you look down on it. きみ　なんて = 'the likes of you'.

patterns.name: 〜で十分
patterns.span: あたしで　じゅうぶん
patterns.explanation: で before じゅうぶん names what is enough for the job, with the feeling that nothing better is needed. あたしで　じゅうぶん = 'I'm enough'.
